status: post hoc and exploratory; criteria in criteria.json were written before computing; changes no preregistered decision

analysis_2a_partner_decomposition.framing: a decomposition of the within-drug AUROC by partner structure, never a replacement for H1

statistics.partner_stratified: positives and negatives that share the same partner (pairs (d1, p) positive and (d2, p) negative, d1 != d2) are compared within partner and combined across partners with weights equal to the number of comparisons (Mann-Whitney pooled over partner strata); this is the statistic the request defines and it is the primary one; it removes partner effects but compares different drugs
statistics.doubly_matched_tetrad: every set of two drugs and two partners with (d1, p1) and (d2, p2) positive and (d1, p2) and (d2, p1) negative; a tetrad is a win when s(d1, p1) + s(d2, p2) > s(d1, p2) + s(d2, p1), ties 0.5; additive drug and partner effects cancel exactly; secondary

analysis_2a_partner_decomposition.intervals: two-way cluster bootstrap (primary) and one-way drug bootstrap, on the same draws as the within-drug AUROC so that shifts are paired; comparison weights: within drug w_d w_p w_p', within partner w_p w_d w_d', tetrad w_d1 w_d2 w_p1 w_p2
analysis_2a_partner_decomposition.systems_and_cells: DrugBank lookup first, then b2mixed, Qwen names only, b1names, b2sentence; Older-clean and Novel; tiers A and B
analysis_2a_partner_decomposition.validity_condition: a statistic is a valid decomposition on a cohort and tier only if the DrugBank lookup keeps its signal under it: its two-way 95% lower bound is above 0.5; on tier B DrugBank is 1.0 by construction and the condition is checked on tier A; a statistic that fails the condition on Older-clean tier A yields no explained verdict
analysis_2a_partner_decomposition.explained: the partner-controlled statistic's two-way 95% interval contains 0.5 AND |S - 0.5| <= |W - 0.5| - 0.03, where S is the statistic and W the within-drug AUROC of the same system and cell (for W = 0.452: S in [0.482, 0.518]), AND the validity condition holds
analysis_2a_partner_decomposition.secondary_verdicts: the same rule for the tetrad statistic and for the one-way intervals; tier B and the other systems are reported without a decision
analysis_2a_partner_decomposition.not_used: the leave-one-drug-out partialling of exp7 is not used as an explanation because it drives DrugBank to 0.398

analysis_2b_popularity_simulation.feature: label-free partner popularity pop(p) = share of vocabulary Drug Interactions sections naming the partner (baselines.Context.partner_prior, as exp7 iii2), converted to normal scores of its ranks in the cohort
analysis_2b_popularity_simulation.scorer: s = lambda x z(pop) + e, e standard normal, lambda in {-5, -2, -1, -0.5, -0.25, 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 5} and the noise-free limits +inf and -inf; 300 noise replicates per lambda, seed 21, on the exact frozen Older-clean and Novel designs, tiers A and B
analysis_2b_popularity_simulation.primary_statistic: mean within-drug AUROC of the scorer at each lambda; the lambda at which the mean within-drug Spearman with popularity equals the measured b2mixed value (computed in this analysis on the same rows; exp7 gave 0.257 on Older-clean tier A), found by linear interpolation, and the scorer's AUROC there; and the lambda, if any, at which the scorer's AUROC equals the measured b2mixed within-drug AUROC
analysis_2b_popularity_simulation.popularity_explains: the popularity scorer matched to b2mixed's Spearman reaches at least half of b2mixed's gap from 0.5 (for 0.452: an AUROC of at most 0.476)
analysis_2b_popularity_simulation.contrast: the same simulation with the label-derived leave-one-drug-out partner positive rate instead of popularity, reported without a decision as an upper bound on what partner structure can do

analysis_2c_decomposition.partner_component_from_2a: within-drug AUROC minus the partner-stratified AUROC (and minus the tetrad AUROC), with paired two-way and one-way intervals; residual = partner-controlled AUROC minus 0.5
analysis_2c_decomposition.popularity_component_from_2b: AUROC of the matched popularity scorer minus 0.5; residual = b2mixed within-drug AUROC minus that value; interval from 1,000 one-way drug bootstrap draws (seed 42 Older-clean, 1042 Novel) in which b2mixed's within-drug AUROC and Spearman are recomputed and the Spearman is mapped through the simulated curve
analysis_2c_decomposition.reported_for: b2mixed, Older-clean and Novel, tiers A and B; primary b2mixed Older-clean tier A
